claims.statement: Access guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES. Organization project admins manage organization, teams, members and eligible outsiders; user project admins invite individual collaborators. Documentation is not actual authorization or current effective-role evidence.

Project admins can change project visibility; public visibility is a separate audience dimension from organization base role and individual grants. No-access base wording must not be treated as internet-private guarantee.

Base permission changes affect non-owner organization members without individual access; organization owners remain project admins. Team grants and public visibility require separate effective-access reconciliation rather than assuming base removal revokes all access.
Organization-level default base permission applies to new projects and projects without configured base role, not every existing explicitly configured project.

Base choices No access, Read, Write and Admin govern respective project view/edit/admin access. Source No access bullet omits team-grant discussion elsewhere; do not infer team grants absent or automatically revoked.
Team read-or-greater access displays project on team projects page; linking/display is distinct from independently verified grant and repository item access.

Individual invitation to organization project requires organization membership or outside-collaborator status on at least one organization repository. Eligible status is not blanket permission to all repositories.
Collaborator roles Read=view, Write=view/edit, Admin=view/edit/add collaborators. Role selection/invite is configuration intent, not accepted invitation or verified behavior.
Existing collaborator roles can be changed or removed after filtering by type/role; removal of one grant does not prove effective revocation through other grants, owner status or public visibility.

User-project note explicitly separates project collaborator access from underlying repository permissions; viewing private-repository items requires repository access. Project grant must not be treated as repository grant or proof all metadata remains private.

Procedural settings navigation is not native mutation authority. No invitations, removals, base-role or visibility changes performed; all claims reference-only pending effective access, rights and accepted policy evidence.
